title: Parkfairfax
meta_title: Dentist Near Parkfairfax, Alexandria, VA | West Alexandria Dental Care
meta_description: Minutes from Parkfairfax along Quaker Lane to West Alexandria Dental Care in the Bradlee Office Building. A new comprehensive family practice with seven-day.
intro: Parkfairfax's garden condos along Quaker Lane and Martha Custis Drive are about as close to our office as a neighborhood can be without being Seminary Hill. A few minutes south on Quaker Lane brings you to W. Braddock Road and the Bradlee Office Building, with free parking at the door and hours that run from 7 AM to 8 PM on weekdays and through weekend mornings.

sections.heading: Who we see from Parkfairfax
body: A mix that reflects the neighborhood: first-time buyers who chose Parkfairfax for the price and the trees, long-time residents who have been there for decades, and commuters who use the bus along Quaker Lane or drive to the Pentagon and the District. The long-time residents often arrive with a dentist who retired or moved; the newer ones often arrive with no dentist at all. Both get the same first visit: a conversation, an exam, and a written plan.
Because the drive is so short, Parkfairfax patients tend to use the early slots: a 7 AM cleaning and still at a desk by 8:30.

items.title: Via Quaker Lane
items.body: South on Quaker Lane to W. Braddock Road, then a short distance to the Bradlee Office Building beside Bradlee Shopping Center. A few minutes door to door.

items.title: Via Valley Drive and King Street
items.body: An alternative route through the neighborhood to King Street and then W. Braddock Road.

items.title: By bus
items.body: Routes along Quaker Lane and King Street stop near Bradlee Shopping Center; check the current schedule.

items.title: Parking
items.body: Free surface parking around the building.

sections.heading: What Parkfairfax patients most often come in for

items.title: Cleanings and exams
items.body: Six-month check-ups at times that fit a commute, including 7 AM starts.

items.title: Care for older adults
items.body: Dry mouth, root decay, denture fit and implants for long-time residents.

items.title: A new dental home
items.body: Records transferred from a retired or distant dentist, and a fresh start.

items.title: Restorative work close to home
items.body: Crowns, root canals and implants done in the building rather than referred across the region.

sections.heading: Practical things worth knowing
items: Open 7 AM to 8 PM Monday to Friday and 8 AM to 1 PM on Saturday and Sunday.
Aetna, Ameritas, Delta Dental, Humana, Cigna, MetLife and Virginia Medicaid accepted.
Care in English, Arabic, Spanish and Portuguese.
Paperwork completed online before you arrive, through the {{forms}}.
Booking online around the clock, or by phone at {{phone}}.

sections.heading: Nervous after a long gap?
sections.body: Say so when you book. A first visit can be a conversation only, and the exam waits for the second. We plan comfort first.

faqs.q: How close is the office to Parkfairfax?
faqs.a: A few minutes south on Quaker Lane. The office is in the Bradlee Office Building on W. Braddock Road, beside Bradlee Shopping Center, with free parking.

faqs.q: Can I get in before work?
faqs.a: Yes. The first appointments start at 7 AM on weekdays, which is one of the most popular slots for Parkfairfax and Fairlington patients.

faqs.q: My dentist retired. Can you get my records?
faqs.a: Yes. You are entitled to your records and X-rays, and we can request them for you from the previous office or whoever took over the practice.

faqs.q: Do you see seniors who have trouble getting around?
faqs.a: Yes. Parking is at the door and the office is in an office building; call ahead and we will help you plan the visit, including a companion in the room.

cta.heading: A few minutes down Quaker Lane.
cta.body: Book online at any hour or call, and keep your dentist close to home.
